options.name: config_ocean_run_mode
options.description: Determines which run mode will be used for the ocean model.

options.name: config_do_restart
options.description: Determines if the initial conditions should be read from a restart file, or an input file.

options.name: config_restart_timestamp_name
options.description: Path to the filename for restart timestamps to be read and written from.

options.name: config_start_time
options.description: Timestamp describing the initial time of the simulation. If it is set to 'file', the initial time is read from restart_timestamp.

options.name: config_stop_time
options.description: Timestamp descriping the final time of the simulation. If it is set to 'none' the final time is determined from config_start_time and config_run_duration.

options.name: config_run_duration
options.description: Timestamp describing the length of the simulation. If it is set to 'none' the duration is determined from config_start_time and config_stop_time. config_run_duration overrides inconsistent values of config_stop_time.

options.name: config_calendar_type
options.description: Selection of the type of calendar that should be used in the simulation.

options.name: config_write_output_on_startup
options.description: Logical flag determining if an output file should be written prior to the first time step.

options.name: config_pio_num_iotasks
options.description: Integer specifying how many IO tasks should be used within the PIO library. A value of 0 causes all MPI tasks to also be IO tasks. IO tasks are requried to write contiguous blocks of data to a file.

options.name: config_pio_stride
options.description: Integer specifying the stride of each IO task.

options.name: config_num_halos
options.description: Determines the number of halo cells extending from a blocks owned cells (Called the 0-Halo). The default of 3 is the minimum that can be used with monotonic advection.

options.name: config_block_decomp_file_prefix
options.description: Defines the prefix for the block decomposition file. Can include a path. The number of blocks is appended to the end of the prefix at run-time.

options.name: config_number_of_blocks
options.description: Determines the number of blocks a simulation should be run with. If it is set to 0, the number of blocks is the same as the number of MPI tasks at run-time.

options.name: config_explicit_proc_decomp
options.description: Determines if an explicit processor decomposition should be used. This is only useful if multiple blocks per processor are used.

options.name: config_proc_decomp_file_prefix
options.description: Defines the prefix for the processor decomposition file. This file is only read if config_explicit_proc_decomp is .true. The number of processors is appended to the end of the prefix at run-time.

options.name: config_vert_levels
options.description: Number of vertical levels to create within the configuration.

options.name: config_init_configuration
options.description: Name of configuration to create.

options.name: config_expand_sphere
options.description: Logical flag that controls if a spherical mesh is expanded to an earth sized sphere or not.

options.name: config_realistic_coriolis_parameter
options.description: Logical flag that controls if a spherical mesh will get realistic coriolis parameters or not.

options.name: config_write_cull_cell_mask
options.description: Logicial flag that controls if the cullCell field is written to output.

options.name: config_vertical_grid
options.description: Name of vertical grid to use in configuration generation

options.name: config_1dCVTgenerator_stretch1
options.description: Parameter for the 1D CVT vertical grid generator.

options.name: config_1dCVTgenerator_stretch2
options.description: Parameter for the 1D CVT vertical grid generator.

options.name: config_1dCVTgenerator_dzSeed
options.description: Seed thickness of the first layer for the 1D CVT vertical grid generator.

options.name: config_iterative_init_variable
options.description: Which variable, ssh or landIcePressure, is computed from the other.  If landIcePressure is to be computed, 'landIcePressure_from_top_density' indicates that the top density (rather than the mean density displaced by land ice) should be used to compute the landIcePressure.

options.name: config_dt
options.description: Length of model time-step.

options.name: config_time_integrator
options.description: Time integration method.

options.name: config_vert_coord_movement
options.description: Determines the vertical coordinate movement type. 'uniform_stretching' distributes SSH perturbations through all vertical levels (z-star vertical coordinate); 'fixed' places them all in the top level (z-level vertical coordinate); 'user_specified' allows the input file to determine the distribution using the variable vertCoordMovementWeights (weighted z-star vertical coordinate); and 'impermeable_interfaces' makes the vertical transport between layers zero, i.e. $w^t=0$ (idealized isopycnal).

options.name: config_use_min_max_thickness
options.description: If true, a minimum and maximum thicknesses are enforced to prevent massless and very thick layers.

options.name: config_min_thickness
options.description: Minimum thickness allowed.

options.name: config_max_thickness_factor
options.description: Maximum thickness allowed. This is a factor times the resting thickness, i.e., maximum thickness = config_max_thickness_factor*$h^{rest}$.

options.name: config_dzdk_positive
options.description: Determines if the positive Z axis is aligned with the positive K index direction.

options.name: config_use_freq_filtered_thickness
options.description: If true, $h^{hf}$ is included in the desired ALE thickness, and the prognostic equations for $D^{lf}$ and $h^{hf}$ are integrated in the code.

options.name: config_thickness_filter_timescale
options.description: Filter time scale for the low-frequency baroclinic divergence, $\tau_{Dlf}$.

options.name: config_use_highFreqThick_restore
options.description: If true, the high frequency thickness prognostic equation ($h^{hf}$) includes term 2 on the RHS, the restoring term.  The high frequency thickness is restored to zero with time scale $\tau_{hhf}$.

options.name: config_highFreqThick_restore_time
options.description: Restoring time scale for high-frequency thickness, $\tau_{hhf}$.

options.name: config_use_highFreqThick_del2
options.description: If true, high frequency thickness prognostic equation ($h^{hf}$) includes term 3 on the RHS, the diffusion term.

options.name: config_highFreqThick_del2
options.description: Horizonal high frequency thickness diffusion, $\kappa_{hhf}$.

options.name: config_alter_ICs_for_pbcs
options.description: If true, initial conditions are altered according to the config_pbc_alteration_type flag. The alteration of layer thickness only occurs when config_do_restart is false, i.e. on an initial run.

options.name: config_pbc_alteration_type
options.description: Determines the method of initial condition alteration for partial bottom cells. 'partial_cell' alters layerThickness, interpolates all tracers in the bottom cell based on the bottomDepth variable, and alters bottomDepth to enforce the minimum pbc fraction. 'full_cell' alters bottomDepth to have full cells everywhere, based on the refBottomDepth variable.

options.name: config_min_pbc_fraction
options.description: Determines the minimum fraction of a cell altering the initial conditions can create. The alteration of layer thickness only occurs when config_do_restart is false, i.e. on an initial run.

options.name: config_hmix_scaleWithMesh
options.description: If false, del2 and del4 coefficients are constant throughout the mesh (equivalent to setting $\rho_m=1$ throughout the mesh).  If true, these coefficients scale as mesh density to the -3/4 power.

options.name: config_maxMeshDensity
options.description: Global maximum of the mesh density

options.name: config_apvm_scale_factor
options.description: Anticipated potential vorticity (APV) method scale factor, $c_{apv}$. When zero, APV is off.

options.name: config_use_mom_del2
options.description: If true, Laplacian horizontal mixing is used on the momentum equation.

options.name: config_use_tracer_del2
options.description: If true, Laplacian horizontal mixing is used on the tracer equation.

options.name: config_mom_del2
options.description: Horizonal viscosity, $\nu_h$.

options.name: config_tracer_del2
options.description: Horizonal diffusion, $\kappa_h$.

options.name: config_use_mom_del4
options.description: If true, biharmonic horizontal mixing is used on the momentum equation.

options.name: config_use_tracer_del4
options.description: If true, biharmonic horizontal mixing is used on the tracer equation.

options.name: config_mom_del4
options.description: Coefficient for horizontal biharmonic operator on momentum.

options.name: config_mom_del4_div_factor
options.description: The divergence portion of the del4 operator is scaled by this factor.

options.name: config_tracer_del4
options.description: Coefficient for horizontal biharmonic operator on tracers.

options.name: config_use_Leith_del2
options.description: If true, the Leith enstrophy-cascade closure is turned on

options.name: config_Leith_parameter
options.description: Non-dimensional Leith closure parameter

options.name: config_Leith_dx
options.description: Characteristic length scale, usually the smallest dx in the mesh

options.name: config_Leith_visc2_max
options.description: Upper bound on the allowable value of Leith-computed viscosity

options.name: config_use_standardGM
options.description: If true, the standard GM for the tracer advection and mixing is turned on. This includes the redi portion which is captured in hmix.

options.name: config_use_Redi_surface_layer_tapering
options.description: If true, the Redi K33 vertical mixing is limited in and just below the ocean boundary layer.

options.name: config_Redi_surface_layer_tapering_extent
options.description: Vertical component of Redi mixing limited in top config_Redi_surface_layer_tapering_extent*boundaryLayerDepth

options.name: config_use_Redi_bottom_layer_tapering
options.description: If true, the Redi K33 vertical mixing is limited in bottom boundary layer.

options.name: config_Redi_bottom_layer_tapering_depth
options.description: Vertical component of Redi mixing limited in bottom config_Redi_surface_layer_tapering_depth

options.name: config_standardGM_tracer_kappa
options.description: Coefficient of standard GM parametrization of eddy transport (Bolus component), $\kappa$

options.name: config_Redi_kappa
options.description: The Redi diffusion coefficient

options.name: config_gravWaveSpeed_trunc
options.description: Gravity wave speed truncation threshold for the vertical stream function boundary value problem, $c$

options.name: config_max_relative_slope
options.description: Tapering parameter for Redi diffusion coeffient.  Tapering occurs when relativeSlopeTopOfEdge is greater than config_max_relative_slope

options.name: config_use_mom_del2_tensor
options.description: If true, tensor-based Laplacian horizontal mixing is used on the momentum equation. The tensor-based mixing operations are provided to show the functionality of the tensor subroutines. Tensor-based del2 mixing is not fully vetted and not recommended for production simulations.

options.name: config_mom_del2_tensor
options.description: Horizonal viscosity, $\nu_h$.

options.name: config_use_mom_del4_tensor
options.description: If true, tensor-based biharmonic horizontal mixing is used on the momentum equation. The tensor-based mixing operations are provided to show the functionality of the tensor subroutines. Tensor-based del4 mixing is not fully vetted and not recommended for production simulations.

options.name: config_mom_del4_tensor
options.description: Coefficient for horizontal biharmonic operator on momentum.

options.name: config_Rayleigh_friction
options.description: If true, Rayleigh friction is included in the momentum equation at every depth level.

options.name: config_Rayleigh_damping_coeff
options.description: Inverse-time coefficient for the Rayleigh damping term, $c_R$, applied at every depth level.

options.name: config_Rayleigh_bottom_friction
options.description: If true, Rayleigh friction is only applied to the bottom

options.name: config_Rayleigh_bottom_damping_coeff
options.description: Inverse-time coefficient for the Rayleigh damping term, $c_R$, only applied at the bottom.

options.name: config_use_cvmix
options.description: If true, use the Community Vertical MIXing routines to compute vertical diffusivity and viscosity

options.name: config_cvmix_prandtl_number
options.description: Prandtl number to be used within the CVMix parameterization suite

options.name: config_use_cvmix_background
options.description: If true, background diffusivity and viscosity is computed using CVMix

options.name: config_cvmix_background_diffusion
options.description: Background vertical diffusion applied to tracer quantities

options.name: config_cvmix_background_viscosity
options.description: Background vertical viscosity applied to horizontal velocity

options.name: config_use_cvmix_convection
options.description: If true, convective diffusivity and viscosity is computed using CVMix

options.name: config_cvmix_convective_diffusion
options.description: Convective vertical diffusion applied to tracer quantities

options.name: config_cvmix_convective_viscosity
options.description: Convective vertical viscosity applied to horizontal velocity components

options.name: config_cvmix_convective_basedOnBVF
options.description: If true, convection is triggered based on value of config_cvmix_convective_triggerBVF

options.name: config_cvmix_convective_triggerBVF
options.description: Value of Brunt Viasala frequency squared below which convective mixing is triggered

options.name: config_use_cvmix_shear
options.description: If true, shear-based mixing is computed using CVMix

options.name: config_cvmix_num_ri_smooth_loops
options.description: Number of smoothing passes over RiTopOfCell for LMD94 shear instability mixing

options.name: config_cvmix_use_BLD_smoothing
options.description: If true KPP bld is smoothed with a laplacian filter

options.name: config_cvmix_shear_mixing_scheme
options.description: Choose between Pacanowski/Philander or Large et al. shear mixing

options.name: config_cvmix_shear_PP_nu_zero
options.description: Numerator of Pacanowski and Philander (1981) Eq (1)

options.name: config_cvmix_shear_PP_alpha
options.description: Alpha values used in Pacanowski and Philander (1981) Eqs (1) and (2)

options.name: config_cvmix_shear_PP_exp
options.description: Exponent used in denominator of Pacanowski and Philander (1981) Eqs (1)

options.name: config_cvmix_shear_KPP_nu_zero
options.description: Maximum diffusivity produced by shear-generated mixing

options.name: config_cvmix_shear_KPP_Ri_zero
options.description: Theshold gradient Richardson number to produced enhanced diffusivities, See Large et al. (1994) Eq (28a,b,c)

options.name: config_cvmix_shear_KPP_exp
options.description: Exponent relating diffusivities to $Ri_g$. Referred to as $p_1$ in Large et al. (1994) Eq (28b)

options.name: config_use_cvmix_tidal_mixing
options.description: If true, diffusivity and viscosity is computed using CVMix tidal mixing

options.name: config_use_cvmix_double_diffusion
options.description: If true, diffusivity and viscosity is computed using CVMix double diffusion

options.name: config_use_cvmix_kpp
options.description: If true, diffusivity and viscosity is computed using CVMix KPP

options.name: config_use_cvmix_fixed_boundary_layer
options.description: If true, boundary layer depth is specified as config_cvmix_kpp_boundary_layer_depth

options.name: config_cvmix_kpp_boundary_layer_depth
options.description: If config_use_cvmix_fixed_boundary_layer, then KPP OBL calculation is overwritten with this value

options.name: config_cvmix_kpp_criticalBulkRichardsonNumber
options.description: Critical bulk Richardson number used to determine bottom of ocean mixed layer

options.name: config_cvmix_kpp_matching
options.description: Determines how the KPP diffusivities are matched to values at base of boundary layer

options.name: config_cvmix_kpp_EkmanOBL
options.description: If true, boundary layer depth is limited by Ekman layer depth

options.name: config_cvmix_kpp_MonObOBL
options.description: If true, boundary layer depth is limited by Monin-Obukhov layer depth

options.name: config_cvmix_kpp_interpolationOMLType
options.description: Determine bottom of ocean mixed layer using linear, quadratic or cubic interpolation

options.name: config_cvmix_kpp_surface_layer_extent
options.description: The non-dimensional extent of the surface layer, measured as fraction of boundary layer depth

options.name: config_cvmix_kpp_surface_layer_averaging
options.description: The thickness over which to average when computing surface-averaged velocity and buoyancy

options.name: configure_cvmix_kpp_minimum_OBL_under_sea_ice
options.description: The minimum allowable boundary layer depth with sea-ice is present

options.name: config_cvmix_kpp_stop_OBL_search
options.description: The search for boundary layer depth is terminated when bulk Richardson number is greater than config_cvmix_kpp_stop_OBL_search*config_cvmix_kpp_criticalBulkRichardsonNumber

options.name: config_cvmix_kpp_use_enhanced_diff
options.description: Flag for use of enhanced diffusion at boundary layer base as in Large et al (1994)

options.name: config_cvmix_kpp_nonlocal_with_implicit_mix
options.description: flag that moves the non-local computation and application of tendency to after main timestep loop

options.name: config_use_const_visc
options.description: If true, constant vertical viscosity is included in the momentum equation

options.name: config_use_const_diff
options.description: If true, constant vertical diffusion is included in the tracer equation

options.name: config_vert_visc
options.description: Vertical viscosity, applied uniformly throughout domain

options.name: config_vert_diff
options.description: Vertical diffusion, applied uniformly throughout domain

options.name: config_use_rich_visc
options.description: If true, Richardson-number based vertical viscosity is included in the momentum equation

options.name: config_use_rich_diff
options.description: If true, Richardson-number based vertical diffusion is included in the tracer equation

options.name: config_bkrd_vert_visc
options.description: Background vertical viscosity for Richardson-number based vertical mixing, $\nu_{bkrd}$

options.name: config_bkrd_vert_diff
options.description: Background vertical diffusion for Richardson-number based vertical mixing, $\kappa_{bkrd}$

options.name: config_rich_mix
options.description: Coefficient for Richardon-number vertical mixing function, $c_{Ri}$

options.name: config_convective_visc
options.description: Value of vertical viscosity to be used in unstable conditions (i.e. Richardson number less than zero)

options.name: config_convective_diff
options.description: Value of vertical diffusion to be used in unstable conditions (i.e. Richardson number less than zero)

options.name: config_use_tanh_visc
options.description: If true, tanh-based vertical viscosity is included in the momentum equation

options.name: config_use_tanh_diff
options.description: If true, tanh-based vertical diffusion is included in the tracer equation

options.name: config_max_visc_tanh
options.description: maximum viscosity value for tanh-fit function

options.name: config_min_visc_tanh
options.description: minimum viscosity value for tanh-fit function

options.name: config_max_diff_tanh
options.description: maximum diffusion value for tanh-fit function

options.name: config_min_diff_tanh
options.description: minimum diffusion value for tanh-fit function

options.name: config_zMid_tanh
options.description: z-coodinate location of center of tanh function

options.name: config_zWidth_tanh
options.description: vertical width parameter for tanh function

options.name: config_use_bulk_wind_stress
options.description: Controls if zonal and meridional components of windstress are used to build surface wind stress.

options.name: config_use_bulk_thickness_flux
options.description: Controls if a bulk thickness flux will be computed for surface forcing.

options.name: config_flux_attenuation_coefficient
options.description: The length scale of exponential decay of surface fluxes. Fluxes are multiplied by $e^{z/\gamma}$, where this coefficient is $\gamma$.

options.name: config_flux_attenuation_coefficient_runoff
options.description: The length scale of exponential decay of river runoff. Fluxes are multiplied by $e^{z/\gamma}$, where this coefficient is $\gamma$.

options.name: config_ssh_grad_relax_timescale
options.description: Timescale for relaxation of the ssh gradient for coupling. A value of 0.0 (default) removes any relaxation and gives instantaneous response.

options.name: config_sw_absorption_type
options.description: Name of shortwave absorption type used in simulation.

options.name: config_jerlov_water_type
options.description: Integer value defining the water type used in Jerlov short wave absorption.

options.name: config_surface_buoyancy_depth
options.description: Depth over which to apply penetrating SW to sfcBuoyancyFlux

options.name: config_use_frazil_ice_formation
options.description: Controls if fluxes related to frazil ice process are computed.

options.name: config_frazil_in_open_ocean
options.description: If frazil formation is used, controls if frazil fluxes are computed in the open ocean (as opposed to under land ice).

options.name: config_frazil_under_land_ice
options.description: If frazil formation is used, controls if frazil fluxes are computed under land ice.

options.name: config_frazil_heat_of_fusion
options.description: Energy per kilogram released when sea water freezes. NOTE: test and make consistent with ACME.

options.name: config_frazil_ice_density
options.description: Assumed density of frazil. NOTE: test and make consistent with ACME.

options.name: config_frazil_fractional_thickness_limit
options.description: maximum fraction of layer thickness than can be used or created at an instant by frazil.

options.name: config_specific_heat_sea_water
options.description: Energy per kilogram per C needed to raise ocean temperature 1 C. NOTE: test and make consistent with ACME.

options.name: config_frazil_maximum_depth
options.description: maximum depth for the formation of frazil

options.name: config_frazil_sea_ice_reference_salinity
options.description: assumed salinity of frazil ice in the open ocean.

options.name: config_frazil_land_ice_reference_salinity
options.description: assumed salinity of frazil ice under land ice.

options.name: config_frazil_maximum_freezing_temperature
options.description: Maximum freezing temperature for the creation of frazil

options.name: config_frazil_use_surface_pressure
options.description: Flag that controls if frazil formation will exert a surface pressure as it is formed.

options.name: config_land_ice_flux_mode
options.description: Selects the mode in which land-ice fluxes are computed.

options.name: config_land_ice_flux_formulation
options.description: Name of land-ice flux formulation.

options.name: config_land_ice_flux_useHollandJenkinsAdvDiff
options.description: If .true. then uses the advection/diffusion scheme of Holland and Jenkins (1999) for ice-shelf heat fluxes

options.name: config_land_ice_flux_attenuation_coefficient
options.description: The vertical length scale of exponential decay for surface fluxes under land ice.

options.name: config_land_ice_flux_boundaryLayerThickness
options.description: The thickness of the sub-ice-shelf boundary layer, over which T and S will be averaged.

options.name: config_land_ice_flux_boundaryLayerNeighborWeight
options.description: The for horizontal neighbors used to horizontally smooth boundary layer T and S.

options.name: config_land_ice_flux_cp_ice
options.description: The specific heat capacity for ice.

options.name: config_land_ice_flux_rho_ice
options.description: The density of land ice.

options.name: config_land_ice_flux_topDragCoeff
options.description: The top drag coefficient.

options.name: config_land_ice_flux_ISOMIP_gammaT
options.description: The constant heat transport velocity through the boundary layer under land ice used in the ISOMIP test cases.

options.name: config_land_ice_flux_rms_tidal_velocity
options.description: Parameterization of tidal velocity used in computing the sub-ice-shelf friction velocity

options.name: config_land_ice_flux_jenkins_heat_transfer_coefficient
options.description: constant nondimensional heat transfer coefficient across the ice-ocean boundary layer

options.name: config_land_ice_flux_jenkins_salt_transfer_coefficient
options.description: constant nondimensional salt transfer coefficient across the ice-ocean boundary layer

options.name: config_vert_tracer_adv
options.description: Method for interpolating tracer values from layer centers to layer edges

options.name: config_vert_tracer_adv_order
options.description: Order of polynomial used for tracer reconstruction at layer edges

options.name: config_horiz_tracer_adv_order
options.description: Order of polynomial used for tracer reconstruction at cell edges

options.name: config_coef_3rd_order
options.description: Reconstruction of 3rd-order reconstruction to blend with 4th-order reconstuction

options.name: config_monotonic
options.description: If .true. then fluxes are limited to produce a monotonic advection scheme

options.name: config_use_implicit_bottom_drag
options.description: If true, implicit bottom drag is used on the momentum equation.

options.name: config_implicit_bottom_drag_coeff
options.description: Dimensionless bottom drag coefficient, $c_{drag}$.

options.name: config_use_explicit_bottom_drag
options.description: If true, explicit bottom drag is used on the momentum equation.

options.name: config_explicit_bottom_drag_coeff
options.description: Dimensionless bottom drag coefficient, $c_{drag}$.

options.name: config_density0
options.description: Density used as a coefficient of the pressure gradient terms, $\rho_0$. This is a constant due to the Boussinesq approximation.

options.name: config_pressure_gradient_type
options.description: Form of pressure gradient terms in momentum equation. For most applications, the gradient of pressure and layer mid-depth are appropriate.  For isopycnal coordinates, one may use the gradient of the Montgomery potential.

options.name: config_common_level_weight
options.description: The weight between standard Jacobian and weighted Jacobian, $\gamma$.

options.name: config_eos_type
options.description: Character string to choose EOS formulation

options.name: config_open_ocean_freezing_temperature_coeff_0
options.description: The freezing temperature at zero pressure in open ocean.

options.name: config_open_ocean_freezing_temperature_coeff_S
options.description: The coefficient for the term proportional to salinity in the freezing temperature in the open ocean.

options.name: config_open_ocean_freezing_temperature_coeff_p
options.description: The coefficient for the term proportional to the (limited) pressure in the freezing temperature in the open ocean.

options.name: config_open_ocean_freezing_temperature_coeff_pS
options.description: The coefficient for the term proportional to salinity times pressure in the freezing temperature in the open ocean.

options.name: config_open_ocean_freezing_temperature_reference_pressure
options.description: The reference pressure above which the freezing temperature is equal to config_freezing_temperature_coeff_0 in the open ocean.

options.name: config_land_ice_cavity_freezing_temperature_coeff_0
options.description: The freezing temperature at zero pressure in land-ice cavities.

options.name: config_land_ice_cavity_freezing_temperature_coeff_S
options.description: The coefficient for the term proportional to salinity in the freezing temperature in land-ice cavities.

options.name: config_land_ice_cavity_freezing_temperature_coeff_p
options.description: The coefficient for the term proportional to the (limited) pressure in the freezing temperature in land-ice cavities.

options.name: config_land_ice_cavity_freezing_temperature_coeff_pS
options.description: The coefficient for the term proportional to salinity times pressure in the freezing temperature in land-ice cavities.

options.name: config_land_ice_cavity_freezing_temperature_reference_pressure
options.description: The reference pressure above which the freezing temperature is equal to config_freezing_temperature_coeff_0 in land-ice cavities.

options.name: config_eos_linear_alpha
options.description: Linear thermal expansion coefficient

options.name: config_eos_linear_beta
options.description: Linear haline contraction coefficient

options.name: config_eos_linear_Tref
options.description: Reference temperature

options.name: config_eos_linear_Sref
options.description: Reference salinity

options.name: config_eos_linear_densityref
options.description: Reference density, i.e. density when T=Tref and S=Sref

options.name: config_n_ts_iter
options.description: number of large iterations over stages 1-3

options.name: config_n_bcl_iter_beg
options.description: number of iterations of stage 1 (baroclinic solve) on the first split-explicit iteration

options.name: config_n_bcl_iter_mid
options.description: number of iterations of stage 1 (baroclinic solve) on any split-explicit iterations between first and last

options.name: config_n_bcl_iter_end
options.description: number of iterations of stage 1 (baroclinic solve) on the last split-explicit iteration

options.name: config_btr_dt
options.description: Timestep to use for the barotropic mode in the split explicit time integrator

options.name: config_n_btr_cor_iter
options.description: number of iterations of the velocity corrector step in stage 2

options.name: config_vel_correction
options.description: If true, the velocity correction term is included in the horizontal advection of thickness and tracers

options.name: config_btr_subcycle_loop_factor
options.description: Barotropic subcycles proceed from $t$ to $t+n\Delta t$, where $n$ is this configuration option.

options.name: config_btr_gam1_velWt1
options.description: Weighting of velocity in the SSH predictor step in stage 2. When zero, previous subcycle time is used; when one, new subcycle time is used.

options.name: config_btr_gam2_SSHWt1
options.description: Weighting of SSH in the velocity corrector step in stage 2. When zero, previous subcycle time is used; when one, new subcycle time is used.

options.name: config_btr_gam3_velWt2
options.description: Weighting of velocity in the SSH corrector step in stage 2. When zero, previous subcycle time is used; when one, new subcycle time is used.

options.name: config_btr_solve_SSH2
options.description: If true, execute the SSH corrector step in stage 2

options.name: config_conduct_tests
options.description: If true, run testing suite. This is the overarching control on the test suite. Individual flags must be set to true below to conduct each test.

options.name: config_test_tensors
options.description: If true, tensor operations are tested upon start-up.

options.name: config_tensor_test_function
options.description: Character string to choose tensor test fuction

options.name: config_disable_redi_k33
options.description: If true, disables k33 portion of Redi neutral surface mixing.

options.name: config_disable_redi_horizontal_term1
options.description: If true, disables first term in horizonal mixing of Redi neutral surface mixing.

options.name: config_disable_redi_horizontal_term2
options.description: If true, disables first term in horizonal mixing of Redi neutral surface mixing.

options.name: config_disable_redi_horizontal_term3
options.description: If true, disables first term in horizonal mixing of Redi neutral surface mixing.

options.name: config_check_zlevel_consistency
options.description: Enables a run-time check for consistency for a zlevel grid. Ensures relevant variables correctly define the bottom of the ocean.

options.name: config_check_ssh_consistency
options.description: Enables a run-time check to determine if the SSH is within 2m of the surface.  See equation for $\zeta_i$.

options.name: config_filter_btr_mode
options.description: Enables filtering of the barotropic mode.

options.name: config_prescribe_velocity
options.description: Enables a prescribed velocity field. This velocity field is read on input, and remains constant through a simulation.

options.name: config_prescribe_thickness
options.description: Enables a prescribed thickness field. This thickness field is read on input, and remains constant through a simulation.

options.name: config_include_KE_vertex
options.description: If true, the kinetic energy in each cell is computed by blending cell-based and vertex-based values of kinetic energy.

options.name: config_check_tracer_monotonicity
options.description: Enables a change on tracer monotonicity at the end of the monotonic advection routine. Only used if config_monotonic is set to .true.

options.name: config_compute_active_tracer_budgets
options.description: Enables the computation of tracer budget terms

options.name: config_disable_thick_all_tend
options.description: Disables all tendencies on the thickness field.

options.name: config_disable_thick_hadv
options.description: Disable tendencies on the thickness field from horizontal advection.

options.name: config_disable_thick_vadv
options.description: Disables tendencies on the thickness field from vertical advection.

options.name: config_disable_thick_sflux
options.description: Disables tendencies on the thickness field from surface fluxes.

options.name: config_disable_vel_all_tend
options.description: Disables all tendencies on the velocity field.

options.name: config_disable_vel_coriolis
options.description: Diables tendencies on the velocity field from the Coriolis force.

options.name: config_disable_vel_pgrad
options.description: Disables tendencies on the velocity field from the horizontal pressure gradient.

options.name: config_disable_vel_hmix
options.description: Disables tendencies on the velocity field from horizontal mixing.

options.name: config_disable_vel_surface_stress
options.description: Disables tendencies on the velocity field from horizontal surface stresses (e.g. wind stress and top drag).

options.name: config_disable_vel_explicit_bottom_drag
options.description: Disables tendencies on the velocity field from explicit bottom drag

options.name: config_disable_vel_vmix
options.description: Disables tendencies on the velocity field from vertical mixing.

options.name: config_disable_vel_vadv
options.description: Disables tendencies on the velocity field from vertical advection.

options.name: config_disable_tr_all_tend
options.description: Disables all tendencies on tracer fields.

options.name: config_disable_tr_adv
options.description: Disables tendencies on tracer fields from advection, both horizontal and vertical.

options.name: config_disable_tr_hmix
options.description: Disables tendencies on tracer fields from horizontal mixing.

options.name: config_disable_tr_vmix
options.description: Disables tendencies on tracer fields from vertical mixing.

options.name: config_disable_tr_sflux
options.description: Disables tendencies on tracer fields from surface fluxes.

options.name: config_disable_tr_nonlocalflux
options.description: Disables tendencies on the tracer fields from CVMix/KPP nonlocal fluxes.

options.name: config_read_nearest_restart
options.description: This flag is intended for the expert user.  If false, forward model will error out if time given by config_start_time (or Restart_timestamp file if config_start_time='file') does not match any xtime strings in the restart file.  If true, forward model will read in record with xtime nearest to config_start_time.  Note that the restart file name is still given by config_start_time (or Restart_timestamp file), regardless of the state of this flag.

options.name: config_use_rx1_constraint
options.description: Initialize using Haney number constraint under ice shelves

options.name: config_rx1_outer_iter_count
options.description: The number of outer iterations (first smoothing then rx1 constraint) during initialization of the vertical grid.

options.name: config_rx1_inner_iter_count
options.description: The number of iterations used to constrain rx1 in each layer.

options.name: config_rx1_init_inner_weight
options.description: The weight by which layer thicknesses are altered at the beginning of inner iteration. This weight linearly increases to 1.0 by the final iteration.

options.name: config_rx1_max
options.description: The maximum value rx1Max of the Haney number (rx1) after modification of the vertical grid

options.name: config_rx1_horiz_smooth_weight
options.description: Relative weight of horizontal neighbors compared to this cell when smoothing vertical stretching

options.name: config_rx1_vert_smooth_weight
options.description: Relative weight of vertical neighbors compared to this cell when smoothing vertical stretching

options.name: config_rx1_slope_weight
options.description: Weight used to nudge level interfaces toward being flat (thus decreasing the Haney number)

options.name: config_rx1_zstar_weight
options.description: Weight used to nudge vertical stretching toward z-star during each outer iteration

options.name: config_rx1_horiz_smooth_open_ocean_cells
options.description: The size (in cells) of a buffer region around land ice for smoothing.  Smoothing is performed under land ice and in the buffer region of open ocean.

options.name: config_rx1_min_levels
options.description: The minimum number of layers in the ocean column in the smoothed region.

options.name: config_rx1_min_layer_thickness
options.description: The minimum layer thickness in the smoothed region.
